# ABINADWAN Plugins Suite

> An independent, MIT-licensed community plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It provides six independently toggleable components using native Harness services. It is not an official DeepSeek product.

Package: `@abinadwan/dsh-plugins-suite`. The suite ships ready-to-run JavaScript, uses Cordis and native DSH UI and service contracts, and does not require a separate application server. Model and provider compatibility depends on the installed Harness version and configured adapters.

Use published GitHub Releases as the source of truth for available stable versions. Install approved releases using their full 40-character Git commit SHA. The `main` branch is the reviewed release-source branch; `develop` is the integration branch and may contain unreleased changes. Match documentation and code to the revision actually installed. A version bump or passing CI is not a published release or proof of full Desktop acceptance.

## Getting started

- [Project README](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/README.md): Overview, supported installation, updates and development.
- [Published releases](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/releases): Authoritative release notes and published versions.
- [Component details](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/DETAIL.md): Capabilities, defaults, limitations and compatibility.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/README.md): Documentation navigation.
- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): Upstream host project.

## Components

- [Environment & Context](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/DETAIL.md#environment--context): Read-only environment and session inspector, including estimated context and token usage; does not enforce token budgets or provide authoritative billing.
- [Humanizer](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/DETAIL.md#humanizer): Native runtime Skill and independent nine-service Humanizer Studio (introduced in v1.2.0); no guaranteed detector evasion.
- [My Profile](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/DETAIL.md#my-profile): Native Profile settings, response preferences, personal context and JSON backup/restore. Consult the installed revision's privacy rules before sharing data.
- [Direct Chat](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/DETAIL.md#direct-chat): Distinct native chat Sessions within one shared Workspace, with tool-denial policies; not a filesystem or process sandbox.
- [Archive Manager](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/DETAIL.md#chat-control): Authorized archive browsing, search, scoped protection and native restore; not a global access-control boundary or automatic cleanup service.
- [Adaptive Reasoning](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/DETAIL.md#adaptive-reasoning): Manual supported reasoning-effort selection, opt-in local recommendations and aggregate statistics; no automatic effort application or global token budget enforcement.

## Security and limitations

- [Security policy](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Data handling, disclosure, update checks, security boundaries and vulnerability reporting.
- [License](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT license.
- [Third-party notices](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): Attribution and bundled third-party content.

My Profile settings and JSON backups are not encrypted by the suite. Data sent to a selected local or cloud provider follows that provider's handling; disabling components does not erase saved data or earlier disclosures. Update checks contact public GitHub endpoints; installation updates require user confirmation and use the native Host updater. Do not infer full sandboxing, universal privacy enforcement, guaranteed rollback or universal provider support.

## Development and verification

Phase 05 (target v1.2.2) starts from accepted Phase 04 integration. All suite-owned UI must follow all supported native DSH interface languages dynamically, including accessible labels, locale formatting and direction, without losing state or modifying user/provider content. First candidate migrates Environment inspector, tab/guide and header to en/ar/zh/es/fr/de/ja with stable section identity. Direct Chat action and history now also have seven-language catalogs and locale-aware pagination; live switch regression added. Archive hub and navigation now also have seven-language catalogs, locale-aware counts and shared settings status translations. Remaining components and Plugin Manager metadata are pending. See the development architecture guide.

Performance scope: optimize the suite's own code, requests, context, lifecycle and UI; do not treat DSH internals, inference, provider latency, network or hardware as suite defects. Reuse verified evidence and run targeted affected regressions; preserve authorization, privacy and freshness. See the integration development guide for the Phase 04 scope. Phase 04 optimizations reuse the authorized Archive page inventory, memoize Studio catalog capability normalization within the current catalog snapshot, and avoid repeated Environment membership scans on unchanged external-store snapshots; native admission and connection freshness fences remain in place. The owner approved scoped Phase 04 closure/integration on 2026-11-28: exact candidate b71cc93395a7868078cb4037c8c1f5d27b1ed901 passed CI and all three targeted Desktop acceptance cases (owner-supplied Codex reports, DSH 0.2.2-rc.5). See [PR #92](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/pull/92) and the development architecture guide for evidence, the nonreproduced Studio timeout, pending-snapshot observation limit and decisions. Avoided operation counts are not measured CPU, RAM, latency or token savings. Target v1.2.1 remains unpublished pending separate promotion and release approval.

## Documentation maintenance

Review this file with every project modification or improvement. Update affected descriptions, links, compatibility, security and privacy boundaries, release references and verification claims whenever they change. Record an explicit no-impact review when appropriate and distinguish source, fixture and Desktop evidence.

The Humanizer component retains its original runtime Skill and single identity; Arabic and English Plugin Manager descriptions now distinguish the Skill from Humanizer Studio. The [Studio usage guide](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/v1.2.0/plugins/humanizer/README.md) describes Humanize, Rewrite, Improve Style, Professional, Proofread, Shorten, Expand, Translate and Custom, controls and privacy limits. The v1.2.0 release source includes the nine-service Humanizer Studio with owner-only HTTP routes, explicit Profile-local draft/history, elapsed-time feedback, authoritative clipboard buttons, conditional native reasoning effort and a read-only Result. Phase 3.7 adds exact package inventory, an advisory check, update confirmation fencing and aggregate CI. These changes were integrated through [PR #88](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/pull/88).

The [acceptance and security report](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/v1.2.0/docs/plugins/humanizer-studio-acceptance-report.md) preserves exact-candidate `6afb0e2` CI 5/5, Windows/native fixture evidence and nine service samples. The owner closed the scoped security review: HS-BUG-001 light-mode pass, owner-only integration authorization, existing Host/Profile isolation guards, scoped no-auto-persistence evidence (117 files) and tool-free prompt-injection controls. Separate live nonowner and unestablished same-window Profile switching excluded; unexecuted cases remain documented, not passed. No provider retention or universal semantic-fidelity guarantees. The owner subsequently approved v1.2.0 promotion; publication remains governed by GitHub Releases. [CI 46064717684](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/actions/runs/46064717684) passed for `2ee95e6`.

HS-BUG-003 is closed: fix candidate `6afb0e2` passed CI 5/5 and prior Chromium regressions; the owner subsequently confirmed all eight focused Desktop acceptance cases passed, including read-only editing protection and normal copying. The earlier locked-session retest is historical. Separate OS clipboard denial and other release acceptance gates remain outside this closure; see the acceptance report.

The active [branch ruleset](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/rules/28022044) requires PRs and four strict GitHub Actions matrix checks, and blocks deletion and force push on main and develop. The active [version-tag ruleset](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/rules/28202361) blocks updates, deletion and force push for matching version tags and allows creation. Both were read back on 2026-11-27. Future-release immutability remains owner-reported, and existing v1.1.3 reports `immutable=false`. The aggregate gate passed and remains outside the branch ruleset's required check list.
